set.body: Owner direction: Sirin graphics should be every bit as good as browser graphics. Update VISION section 7 and the roadmap; define public drawing capabilities, quality and performance evidence, and a downstream Intaglio acceptance case. Design and planning only; preserve concurrent kernel work. Completion requires documentation checks and sbt testJVM/testNative outcomes.
set.title: G-0: Specify browser-class public graphics API and qualification gates
